_comment: Human-written dialogue corpora (corpus/fetchers/human_dialogue.py; survey corpus/HUMAN_DIALOGUE_SURVEY.md), prepared 23 Oct 2026, NOT launched: the main session launches Colab work. Two CPU data jobs, no GPU work: hd_default builds the permissive set (oasst, convai2, wow, bst, taskmaster, multiwoz, self_dialogue; ~2.7 GB of downloads: Wizard of Wikipedia 0.97 GB, Taskmaster 1-3 0.99 GB, ConvAI2 0.43 GB; hd_optin ~0.4 GB), hd_optin the share-alike, non-commercial and LLM-risk sources (topical_chat, dolly, quac, simplewiki, empathetic, dailydialog, no_robots, aya_en) so their sizes are measured; building them is not using them. Both count tokens with the 16k Llama 3 scheme vocabulary (upload C:/ml_artifacts/capacity/vocab/vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf with the runner's --upload) and the 8k fineweb_tinychat vocabulary the boot fetches. Downloads are deleted after each source's build. At home: copy each human_<source>_v1/ into corpus/data/, then `python corpus/fetchers/human_dialogue.py pin SOURCE` for the sources not yet pinned (oasst, bst, self_dialogue, dolly, quac, empathetic, dailydialog, no_robots and aya_en were built and pinned on the laptop: their VM copies must match those pins), record the ParlAI archives' sha256 from report.json inputs in ARCHIVE_SHA256, and run tools/carry5_build.py decontam on the text.txt files once corpus/eval/carry5_v1.jsonl is frozen.
